sourceOfAuthority: Leader, 2026-10-21: "we want to normalize the names, x-engineering-services-section, x-science-services-section, etc., or just, the straight app or library name. everything proper submodules, and preferably with real repo and packages to help us manage and enforce these norms." House rule every-repository-package-and-section-has-one-home: a section, its package and its repository are one unit, and the directory that composes it is named for its repository. Every placement rule (layout relocations, forbidden paths, manifests, READMEs, mounts, nesting, subject owners) is the section law, kept in the service-section engineering section and the Group section's content taxonomy; this file holds only the naming settings.
